verdict.rationale: Cognee offers manual deletion via `.forget` (single item, dataset, or full cleanup) and a short-term 'session' cache separate from permanent graph memory, which are lifecycle-adjacent features, but there is no documented TTL, expiration-date, or recency-weighting mechanism — the founder only says temporal resolution mechanisms are 'being built,' not shipped. Missing for 10: documented TTL/expiration API, automatic recency-based decay of retrieval relevance, and confirmation that the temporal resolution feature has shipped rather than being in development.
